mappings.assertion: TestS1SizeGuard fails if the submit_review.go file key or the prepareSubmitForReview key is still in area_a5_test.go's ratchet while the code is over the limit, and fails if any remaining key grows. Both keys are removed; prepareSubmitForReview is an orchestrator over the phases readSnapshot, resolvePipeline, checkOwnership (submission_preconditions.go), openWorktree, resolveCandidate, checkCandidate, resolveRebaseBase, loadAcceptance, recordPreparation, rebase, checkRebased (submission_git_work.go), planAdmission (submission_admission.go) and finalize (submission_finalize.go), each file under the limit.

TestOracleA5Supplement compares json, human and state.yaml captures of SB1-SB8 (wrong status, missing pre-execution checkpoint, commit ref not the worktree HEAD, unresolvable commit ref, worktree on the wrong branch, no test file under TDD, task without a worktree, and the rebase conflict routed to INTEGRATION_FAILED with the worktree left on the candidate, clean and not mid-rebase) against goldens committed in 579ed1f5b before any production edit, generated by regen write-new on the unchanged tree. TestSupplementGoldenCoverage pins coverage; regen -mode check -pkg ./internal/oracle/a5/... reproduces every golden.

The submission white-box tests (submit_review_test.go, submission_admission_test.go, lifecycle_submission_restart_test.go, lifecycle_retirement_liveness_test.go, planning_output_acceptance_test.go and the other pre-existing submit tests) run unchanged under the race detector against the phased prepareSubmitForReview; they pin check order, error identity, the preparation marker, the final transaction (status/assignee recheck, bounded correction, receipt recheck) and result projection. TestNotAssignedReasonNamesTheCurrentAssignee pins the refusal text now shared by the snapshot check and the final transaction.

TestSubmissionNamedValuesKeepTheirValues compares each K7 named value of the submission files (rebase diagnostic limit, hold digest bytes, marker nonce bytes, SHA-1 and SHA-256 hex lengths, batch-timeout request ID length, state_write code) with the literal it replaced. Safe actions and effects use the delivered LifecycleSafeAction and LifecycleEffects constants and the doer role type uses roles.RoleTypeDoer; persisted model fields stay strings.
TestOracleA5 compares the delivered A5 goldens live; none changes (git diff of internal/oracle/a5/testdata/golden against the starting commit is empty), and no older supplement golden changes.
TestS1SizeGuard enforces that area_a5_test.go ratchet keys only shrink: the two K-SUB keys are gone and no key was added or raised.
test target (go test ./...) runs the ops, archguard and A5 oracle suites including the new tests; lint, test-e2e and the race run are mandatory with it.
